compartment.title: Investigated and diagnosed OpenCode SIGTRAP crash in ONNX Runtime during team mode
compartment.p1: User reported that opencode sessions crash during team mode execution. Searched system crash reports, desktop app logs, CLI logs, and crash reporter plists across default directories and ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports. U: "my omo sessions keep crashing out during team mode executions" Agent looked in default crash locations and was redirected by the user. U: "Opencode logs are in /Users/brethoffman/.local/share/opencode/log" Found 7 `.ips` crash reports (May 15) all showing the same SIGTRAP (Trace/BPT trap) at the same thread and call stack. The crash is in the ONNX Runtime NAPI native addon: `InferenceSessionWrap::~InferenceSessionWrap()` is called via `FinalizeCallback` during GC, which triggers `Napi::Error::Fatal()` — this deliberately raises SIGTRAP as an unrecoverable state. Diagnosis: the NAPI environment is destroyed before the GC finalizer runs on `InferenceSessionWrap`, or the ORT session encounters an internal error during destruction that propagates through `Napi::Fatal`. Team mode exacerbates the crash because each child session loads its own copy of the native addon, increasing the probability of hitting the finalization race. Recommended workarounds: rebuild from source (`brew install --build-from-source opencode`), reduce concurrent team-mode sessions (max 2-3 instead of 4), or file an upstream issue at github.com/anomalyco/opencode. The Homebrew bottle (v1.15.0) may have a packaging issue with the crashy ONNX Runtime version.
compartment.p2: User reported opencode crashing during team mode. Investigation found 7 `.ips` crash reports with identical SIGTRAP in ONNX Runtime's `InferenceSessionWrap` finalizer. Each team-mode child session loads its own ORT native addon, making the NAPI GC finalization race more likely. U: "Opencode logs are in /Users/brethoffman/.local/share/opencode/log" Root cause: NAPI environment torn down before finalizer runs → `Napi::Fatal` → SIGTRAP. Workaround: reduce concurrent sessions or rebuild from source.
compartment.p3: OpenCode v1.15.0 crashes with SIGTRAP during team mode due to an ONNX Runtime NAPI finalization race in `InferenceSessionWrap`. Team mode's parallel child sessions amplify the crash probability.
compartment.p4: InferenceSessionWrap NAPI finalization race; 7 ips crash reports; concurrent team-mode sessions amplify the SIGTRAP

compartment.title: Began syncing fork with upstream and fixing build
compartment.p1: U: "sync local fork with upstream repo and generate a new build, fix any issues until the build passes" Verified git configuration: remotes origin (rustybret/opencode) and upstream (anomalyco/opencode) are configured, working tree has no staged changes (some untracked files in packages/console), and `dev` branch has 2 local-only commits on top of an older upstream/dev that has since diverged significantly. Fetched upstream and began assessing divergence to start the rebase of fork/local onto upstream/dev. The sync-upstream git alias is available per AGENTS.md workflow.
compartment.p2: U: "sync local fork with upstream repo and generate a new build, fix any issues until the build passes" Verified git remotes, working tree, and divergence. Began the rebase of fork/local onto upstream/dev.
compartment.p3: Began syncing fork/local with upstream/dev for a new build per user directive.

facts.CONFIG_VALUES: * OpenCode log directory (macOS): ~/.local/share/opencode/log — contains crash report `.ips` files and CLI/desktop logs.

causal_incident.summary: ONNX Runtime NAPI finalization crash (SIGTRAP) in InferenceSessionWrap during team mode
causal_incident.symptom: OpenCode v1.15.0 (Homebrew) crashes with SIGTRAP during team mode execution; 7 identical crash reports show the fault at InferenceSessionWrap::~InferenceSessionWrap via FinalizeCallback during GC
causal_incident.cause_summary: NAPI environment destroyed before GC finalizer runs on InferenceSessionWrap, triggering Napi::Error::Fatal which raises SIGTRAP as an unrecoverable state. Team mode amplifies because each child session loads its own native ORT addon instance.
causal_incident.evidence: 7 crash reports showing identical stack: "Napi::Error::Fatal() → … → InferenceSessionWrap::FinalizeCallback"
causal_incident.fix_summary: Rebuild from source (brew install --build-from-source) or reduce concurrent team-mode sessions (max 2-3). Also may be fixed by syncing to a newer upstream release.

output.user_observations: * User is technically deep — comfortable diagnosing native crashes, knows exact log locations, and understands build pipeline details. * User gives concise, direct instructions when redirecting the work direction.
